notes.title: Be ready for Stay Still 2...
notes.notes:
[h1]A better version...[/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537770/Stay_Still_2/][img]https://i.imgur.com/rLt2Lgg.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://galactic-crows.com/stay-still2/]See more on our website![/url]

In direct response to our devoted community's valuable comments, we proudly present "[i][b]Stay Still 2[/b][/i]," the ultimate relaunch of the original "[i][b]Stay Still[/b][/i]." We have deliberately developed an experience that attempts to answer any worries and exceed any previous expectations, taking into account the insights and observations supplied by our gamers.

[b][i]Recognizing that our initial entry into the business may not have met the expected standards, we have worked hard to address those concerns. "[i][b]Stay Still 2[/b][/i]" represents our commitment to ensure that every facet of the game resonates with both existing and new players.[/i][/b]

We rebuilt the game's content and structure after doing extensive feedback analysis. The end product is a painstakingly crafted gameplay trip that keeps the core of what made the original so remarkable while also introducing significant improvements. The addition of new chapters, compelling locales, and creative features all show our commitment to renewing the franchise in a way that addresses community issues and welcomes community wishes.

With "[i][b]Stay Still 2[/b][/i]," we hope to win back gamers who were disappointed by the first installment, as well as to create a welcome environment for those who are venturing into the world of "Stay Still" for the first time. We are pleased to deliver a game that not only keeps true to its roots but also raises the overall gaming experience to new heights by fostering an environment of constant improvement and open debate. Your voices have been heard, and we are excited to have you join us on this revitalized adventure.

Thank you very much for understanding.

- Galactic crows team!

notes.title: Stay Still has been officially launched.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we're very happy to announce that Stay Still, our small indie horror experimental project made by two developers, one with experience working as a teacher to the other developer, has been released. We wanted to help our friend with his vision, so did we, we managed to make this indie horror game together and give our other new developer an in-depth image as how game development works.
We're aware that the game has a couple of flaws, since we've used another programming language aside of C# so this was a bit different of a workflow. Hopefully you'll enjoy this project, and that it will be well received as a small indie horror made by 2 passionate developers. We recommend you to check it out.

- We plan to update & Patch the game, so we're waiting for your feedback.

Thanks a lot, Paul.
